Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it…
Yahweh will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will…

translations.web: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
translations.bsb: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, like a mighty warrior overcome by wine.
translations.kjv: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
translations.asv: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, Like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
